title: Relief Grooves for Grinding Zones and Thread
topics: Dimensional specifications for different diameter ranges
rules: Relief grooves for grinding zones must follow UNI4386 standard with Bonfiglioli TRASMITAL specifications
Diameter range 18-50mm: groove width 2.5mm ±0.1mm, depth 0.4mm, radius R 0.1, angle 30°
Diameter range 51-80mm: groove width 3mm +0.2mm, depth 0.6mm, radius R 1 to 1.6, angle 30°
Diameter range 81-125mm: groove width 4.5mm ±0.3mm, depth 0.8mm, radius R 2.5, angle 30°
Diameter range >125mm: groove width 7mm +0.2/-0mm, depth 1.3mm, radius R4.0, angle 30°
Relief grooves for thread must be made where thread zone ends at a shoulder with ledge function
Thread relief groove dimensions vary by pitch: P ≤1.25 (R=1.2, A=3.3, B=1.2), P=1.5-1.75-2 (R=1.6, A=4.0, B=1.2), P=2.5-3 (R=2.0, A=5.0, B=1.5)
Possible specific grooves must be indicated in details in drawing
dimensions: Groove width range: 2.5mm to 7mm depending on diameter
Groove depth range: 0.4mm to 1.3mm depending on diameter
Groove radius range: R 0.1 to R 4.0 depending on diameter
Thread relief groove dimension A: 3.3mm to 5.0mm
Thread relief groove dimension B: 1.2mm to 1.5mm
Thread relief groove tolerance T1: 0.2mm to 1.5mm
Thread relief groove tolerance T2: 1.2mm to 2.4mm
tolerances: Diameter 81-125mm: width tolerance ±0.3mm, depth tolerance 0.4mm, radius tolerance 0.3mm
Diameter >125mm: width tolerance +0.2/-0mm, depth tolerance 0.3mm, radius tolerance 0.2mm
Thread relief groove B tolerance: 0.2mm to 0.3mm
Thread relief groove T2 tolerance: 1.2mm to 2.4mm
inspection: Verify groove dimensions match specified diameter range
Check groove width, depth, radius and angle conform to standard
Confirm thread relief grooves are present where threads meet shoulders
Verify any specific grooves are detailed in drawing as required
manufacturing_notes: Relief grooves facilitate grinding operations by providing clearance
Grooves must comply with UNI regulation and TRASMITAL specifications
Thread relief grooves are mandatory when thread zone ends at shoulder with ledge function
Specific non-standard grooves require explicit drawing details
Groove dimensions scale with shaft diameter ranges
training_guidance: When modeling shafts with ground surfaces (bearing seats, seal seats), automatically add relief grooves per diameter range
For D=18-50mm grinding zones: create groove 2.5mm wide, 0.4mm deep, R0.1, 30° angle
For D=51-80mm grinding zones: create groove 3mm wide, 0.6mm deep, R1.0-1.6, 30° angle
For D=81-125mm grinding zones: create groove 4.5mm wide, 0.8mm deep, R2.5, 30° angle
For D>125mm grinding zones: create groove 7mm wide, 1.3mm deep, R4.0, 30° angle
When modeling threads ending at shoulders: add thread relief groove based on pitch (P≤1.25: R1.2/A3.3/B1.2; P=1.5-2: R1.6/A4.0/B1.2; P=2.5-3: R2.0/A5.0/B1.5)
Apply appropriate tolerances based on diameter range and feature type
Flag non-standard relief grooves for explicit detailing in drawings
summary: This page defines standard relief groove specifications for grinding zones and threaded features per Bonfiglioli standards TAB-001 and TAB-002. Grinding relief grooves follow UNI4386 with TRASMITAL modifications, scaling in size (2.5-7mm width, 0.4-1.3mm depth) across four diameter ranges (18-50mm, 51-80mm, 81-125mm, >125mm). Thread relief grooves are mandatory where threads meet shoulders, with dimensions varying by thread pitch from P≤1.25 to P=2.5-3, requiring radii from R1.2 to R2.0 and widths from 3.3mm to 5.0mm.
